name: Beacon of Hope

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Chosen creatures within range gain WIS/Death Save Advantage and maximum possible healing for the Concentration duration.

rules.text: Choose any number of creatures within range.
For the duration, each target has Advantage on Wisdom saving throws and Death Saving Throws and regains the maximum number of Hit Points possible from any healing.
